Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 34

“Teachers, fathers, sons, and grandfathers; uncles, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law, and kinsmen as well.”

A list with no verb in it, just relationships — nine categories of family named one after another. Arjuna is not arguing here so much as reading out the roll of who is present.
